tool.name: SpliceAI splice-altering prediction
tool.description: of rare variants in genes, added to the VCF as INFO/SpliceAI
tool.version_command: python -c "import importlib.metadata as m; print('spliceai', m.version('spliceai'))"
tool.command: set -o pipefail && export TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=3 OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS=1 && ln -s '$reference' reference.fa && ## index once here, not concurrently in every SpliceAI process python -c "import pyfaidx; pyfaidx.Fasta('reference.fa')" && ## rare variants only: the selection expression is applied before scoring, everything is passed through ## sites only (no INFO, no samples): the scored records are merged back by CHROM/POS/REF/ALT bcftools view --no-version -G -i '$select' '$input' -Ov 2> select.log | bcftools annotate --no-version -x INFO -Ov > selected.vcf && grep '^#' selected.vcf | grep -v '^#CHROM' > header.vcf && cat '$__tool_directory__/spliceai_header.txt' >> header.vcf && grep '^#CHROM' selected.vcf >> header.vcf && { grep -v '^#' selected.vcf > records.tsv || true; } && n=\$(wc -l < records.tsv) && echo "variants scored: \$n" && jobs=$processes && [ \$jobs -le \$n ] || jobs=\$n && mkdir parts && if [ \$n -gt 0 ]; then split -n r/\$jobs -d -a 3 records.tsv parts/part. && for p in parts/part.???; do cat header.vcf "\$p" > "\$p.vcf"; rm "\$p"; done && ## TensorFlow sizes its thread pools to the visible cores: pin each process to two cores ncpu=\$(nproc --all) && i=0 && for p in parts/*.vcf; do taskset -c \$(( (2 * i) % ncpu )),\$(( (2 * i + 1) % ncpu )) spliceai -I "\$p" -O "\$p.out" -R reference.fa -A $annotation -D $distance -M $mask > "\$p.log" 2>&1 & i=\$((i + 1)); done; wait; for p in parts/*.vcf; do if [ "\$(grep -vc '^#' "\$p")" != "\$(grep -vc '^#' "\$p.out" 2> /dev/null)" ]; then echo "SpliceAI failed on \$p:" >&2; tail -20 "\$p.log" >&2; exit 1; fi; done; fi && { cat header.vcf; cat parts/*.vcf.out 2> /dev/null | grep -v '^#' || true; } | bcftools sort -Oz -o scored.vcf.gz 2> /dev/null && bcftools index -t scored.vcf.gz && ## annotate -a reads both files through their indexes bcftools view --no-version '$input' -Oz -o input.vcf.gz && bcftools index -t input.vcf.gz && bcftools annotate --no-version -a scored.vcf.gz -c INFO/SpliceAI input.vcf.gz -Ov -o '$output'

param.name: reference
param.label: Reference genome (FASTA)
param.help: The FASTA the variants were called against (GRCh38).

param.name: select
param.label: Variants to score (bcftools expression)
param.help: Scoring takes about 3 s per variant per process; by default only variants with gnomAD frequency below 1 % (or absent) are scored. Variants outside the bundled genes get no score.

param.name: distance
param.label: Maximum distance between the variant and a gained or lost splice site (-D)

param.name: processes
param.label: Parallel SpliceAI processes
param.help: Each uses about 2 CPU threads and 0.7 GB of memory. An exome has about 2,500 rare variants in genes; 32 processes score them in about 13 minutes on CPU.

param.name: mask
param.label: Masked scores (-M)
param.help: Raw scores are what ClinGen calibrated (Walker et al. 2023).

tool.help:
**What it does**
Runs SpliceAI 1.3.1 (Jaganathan et al., Cell 2019) on the variants that pass the selection expression (by default those with gnomAD frequency below 1 %) and adds its prediction to every scored record of the full input VCF as ``INFO/SpliceAI=ALT|GENE|DS_AG|DS_AL|DS_DG|DS_DL|DP_AG|DP_AL|DP_DG|DP_DL``: delta scores (0-1) for acceptor gain/loss and donor gain/loss and their positions relative to the variant. Records that were not scored pass through unchanged.
The ClinGen splicing recommendation (Walker et al., AJHG 2023) uses the maximum of the four delta scores: >= 0.2 supports a splicing effect (PP3), <= 0.1 supports no effect (BP4), both at Supporting strength, outside the canonical +/-1,2 splice-site positions.
**Licences**: SpliceAI source code PolyForm Strict 1.0.0 and trained models CC BY-NC 4.0, i.e. non-commercial use. Runs on CPU (TensorFlow); the input is split over the job's slots.
